comments.value: Please fix this VRC so questies can be apart of the experience!
Please add that feature... Quest standalone users are getting an huge part of VRChat !!!

The rtspt:// scheme has now been apart of Exoplayer since the 1.6.1 release. We will have to wait for AVPro to update to it for VRChat to be able to use it, but it should resolve this when it eventually makes its way in
We will aim to string-replace `rtspt://` to `rtsp://` on Android devices for now. It will be a while before we can get to the newest ExoPlayer.

details:
Recently AVPro was updated so that Quest users could watch RTSP streams. I was able to confirm this today, but there is a problem.

For TCP RTSP streams, PC users must use rtspt:// format URLs. However, it would appear that Quest users only support rtsp:// URLs.

Quest should either support rtspt:// format URLs (with a simple string replacement to rtsp:// if necessary), or PC should default to TCP-rtsp when using rtsp://.

This is a world where I tested that rtspt:// streams work, but only on PC, and rtsp:// streams work, but only on Quest: https://vrchat.com/home/world/wrld_2745cae5-eecc-44c4-8de7-1ece6a06bc05
title: Support rtspt:// protocol streams on Quest
